SnapshotGroup.description_en: The information about the snapshot-consistent groups
SnapshotGroup.description_zh: 快照一致性组的信息组成的数组

items.description_en: The details of the snapshot-consistent group

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID to which the snapshot-consistent group belongs. This parameter is returned only when all disk snapshots in the snapshot-consistent group belong to the same instance. If the disk snapshots in the snapshot-consistent group belong to different ECS instances, you can check the `Snapshots.Snapshot.Tags.*` parameter in the response to view the instance ID to which each snapshot belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 快照一致性组所属的实例ID。该参数仅当快照一致性组内的所有云盘快照属于同一实例时有返回值。如果您的快照一致性组内的多个云盘快照分别属于不同的ECS实例，则您可以通过返回结果中的`Snapshots.Snapshot.Tags.*`参数，查看组内单个快照所属的实例ID

Name.description_en: The name of the snapshot-consistent group

ProgressStatus.description_en: This parameter is not publicly available

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the snapshot-consistent group belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 快照一致性组所属的资源组ID

SnapshotGroupId.description_en: The ID of the snapshot-consistent group

Snapshot.description_en: The information about the snapshots in the snapshot-consistent group
Snapshot.description_zh: 快照一致性组中包含的快照信息组成的数组

Available.description_en:
Indicates whether the snapshot can be used to create disks, roll back disks, or share snapshots. Valid values:

true: The snapshot is available.
false: The snapshot is unavailable
Available.description_zh:
快照是否可用于创建云盘、回滚云盘、共享快照。可能值：

true：可用。
false：不可用

InstantAccess.description_en:
Indicates whether snapshot instant access is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled. This feature is enabled by default for enterprise SSD (ESSD) disks.
false: Disabled. The snapshot is a standard snapshot for which instant access is not enabled.

This parameter is deprecated. Standard snapshots of enterprise SSD (ESSD) disks have been upgraded to [instant access by default]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html）. No additional configuration or fees are required
InstantAccess.description_zh:
是否开启了快照极速可用能力。可能值：

true：开启。ESSD云盘默认开启该能力。
false：关闭。即快照为未开启极速可用能力的标准快照。

该参数已弃用。ESSD云盘标准快照已升级为[默认极速可用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html），您无需额外配置，且不产生额外花销

InstantAccessRetentionDays.description_en:
The retention period of the snapshot instant access feature. After the retention period expires, the snapshot is automatically released.

This parameter is deprecated. Standard snapshots of enterprise SSD (ESSD) disks have been upgraded to [instant access by default]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html）. No additional configuration or fees are required
InstantAccessRetentionDays.description_zh:
快照极速可用功能的保留时间，保留时间到期后快照将自动释放。

该参数已弃用。ESSD云盘标准快照已升级为[默认极速可用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html），您无需额外配置，且不产生额外花销

Progress.description_en: The snapshot creation progress, in percentage
Progress.description_zh: 快照创建进度，单位为百分比

SourceDiskId.description_en: The source disk ID. This field is retained even if the source disk has been released
SourceDiskId.description_zh: 源云盘ID。如果快照的源云盘已经被释放，该字段仍旧保留

SourceDiskType.description_en:
The type of the source disk. Valid values:

system: system disk.
data: data disk
SourceDiskType.description_zh:
源云盘类型。可能值：

system：系统盘。
data：数据盘

Tag.description_en: The tag key-value pairs of each snapshot in the snapshot-consistent group. By default, the source information of the snapshot is included
Tag.description_zh: 快照一致性组内各个快照的标签键值对。默认包含了快照来源的信息

Key.description_en: The tag key of each snapshot in the snapshot-consistent group. The default values of Key and Value provide the source information of the snapshot
Key.description_zh: 快照一致性组内各个快照的标签键。Key和Value的默认值中提供了快照来源信息

Value.description_en: The tag value of each snapshot in the snapshot-consistent group. The default values of Key and Value provide the source information of the snapshot
Value.description_zh: 快照一致性组内各个快照的标签值。Key和Value的默认值中提供了快照来源信息

Status.description_en:

accomplished: The snapshot-consistent group is created.

failed: The snapshot-consistent group failed to be created
Status.description_zh:

progressing：创建中。

accomplished：创建成功。

failed：创建失败
